📋 OAuth Scope Justification

Requested Scopes:

  • calendar: Read calendar events to find optimal habit times

🛡️ Data Protection

HabitLoop implements industry-standard security measures:

  • OAuth2 authentication with secure token handling
  • No storage of Google credentials or personal data
  • Minimal data access - only habit-related calendar events
  • User can revoke access anytime through Google Account settings
